sloka: ते नगाग्रान्नगाग्राणि शिखराच्छिखराणि च ।प्रहृष्टाः समपद्यन्त हनूमन्तं दिदृक्षवः ।। 5.57.26 ।।।।
transliteration: te nagāgrānnagāgrāṇi śikharācchikharāṇi ca ।prahṛṣṭāḥ samapadyanta hanūmantaṁ didṛkṣavaḥ ।। 5.57.26 ।।।।

translations.english: Waiting for Hanuman, the vanaras jumped from the tree tops holding the branches. They shook the branches just like clothes to welcome friends.
